scope: Exact six-module HUE1.1/HUE3.1 source and bounded existing check receipts; installation preparation only.
findings: Ordinary HUE action binds current verified private owner, original ingress hash, same project, current stop/dispatch authority and exact retained predecessor before writing.
Action replay preserves exact admission/call/output bindings. Uncertain or unavailable outbox state remains refused; queued does not claim semantic retention.

Current PG lineage rehydrates canonical model-inference records in one read-only snapshot, verifies complete same-kind time-ordered provenance, and follows newer typed successor for recall while exact-parent validation does not.
Unavailable, pending, erased, mismatched or overlong successor refuses stale learning. Cache hits revalidate current source and authority.
Ordinary model context carries newest validated lineage and explicit inference uncertainty; retained consolidation text cannot become direct-user evidence.
Factory exposes existing HUE action/outbox; no additional authority or external service platform.
limitations: Scripted ordinary dialogue and disposable PostgreSQL checks establish source/interface behavior. Real three-turn model/Hindsight learning and human acceptance are not yet demonstrated.
This decision authorizes exact source installation only. Native START requires separately frozen isolated fixture, all-provider measured accounting including Hindsight helpers, and root limits.
Previous eight contract checks and ten PG checks on an earlier revision are retained separately, not added to this 16-node final total.
